notes.title: 3.0 Update!
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]update summary[/b][/i][/h1]

[u]List of changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Removed photo mode

[*] Improved post processing

[*] added a new "aesthetic mode"

[*] minor bugs fixed

[*] Pause fixed

[*] Motion blur removed

[*] annoying puzzle in chapter 3 removed

[*] weird camera fixed

[*] Sky screens in chapter 3 is actually screens now

[*] new achievements added
[/list]

[h1][i][b]More detailed information about the changes:[/b][/i][/h1]

[i][b]PHOTO MODE[/b][/i]

Photo mode was removed due to serious errors it was occuring.

[i][b]NEW MODE[/b][/i]

Aesthetic mode, is mode just for chill. No puzzles, no enemy. Just you and some collectibles.

[h1][u]That's all the big changes![/u][/h1]

[u][b]A new game called "Inner Darkness" Is in active development now! Stay tuned.[/b][/u]

[url=Inner Darkness steam page]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2678060/Inner_Darkness/[/url]

notes.title: 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769237/949c3eeaab90fcf026d20eab0566056b5894d3bb.png[/img]

[h1][i][b]update summary[/b][/i][/h1]

[u]List of changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] added photo mode

[*] improved enemy

[*] added a new location replacing chapter 3

[*] minor bugs fixed

[*] changed the music in the last location of chapter 1

[*] new achievements added
[/list]

[h1][i][b]More detailed information about the changes:[/b][/i][/h1]

[i][b]PHOTO MODE[/b][/i]

Photo mode is now available in the game! How to use it? just press the P key to activate it, and to view the gallery you need to press the G key.
It has a wide enough functionality to create high-quality screenshots.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769237/2a10437685ae1c7de904162451c3918b5bf8d25c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769237/62a238ee581a6a5fdba50e1da9b1bb45e670b31d.png[/img][/url]

[i][b]NEW LOCATION[/b][/i]

Due to the boredom and monotony of the last and in fact climactic location, it was completely replaced with a new one. The new location has a completely different atmosphere and has no notes.

[i][b]ENEMY[/b][/i]

The shadow has become more aggressive and [i]frightening
[/i]

[h1][u]That's all the big changes![/u][/h1]

[u][b]A new part called Project Liminal 2 will be released in the future.[/b][/u]

[i]Do you want to follow the news and the development of new projects? Then you can subscribe to our YouTube [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCiG1r0yXoNIcyyeYmFU-66g]channel[/url]
